name: up-next
title: Up Next
summary: Hold Select to play a song, an album or an artist next or last.
description: Hold Select on a song, an album or an artist while music plays. Settings > Hold Select selects what the hold does: Play Next, Play Last, On-The-Go or Cover Flow.
details: Play Next: the songs play directly after the current song.
Play Last: the songs play after the last song of the list that plays now.
On-The-Go: the songs go into the On-The-Go playlist, as without the patch.
Cover Flow (only with the Cover Flow patch): in the Albums list, the hold opens Cover Flow. In the other lists, the hold does Play Next.
Settings > Hold Select changes the value. Each push of Select moves to the next value.
With Shuffle on, Play Next and Play Last also put the songs in the correct position.
When no music plays, a hold of Select adds the songs to On-The-Go.
notes: The iPod keeps the value in the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmHoldSelect. At the first start without the file, the patch writes the value of the option.
The Cover Flow patch reads the same file. Without the Up Next patch, a hold in the Albums list always opens Cover Flow.
